items.title: Polished gemstone cabochons
items.description:
These are polished gemstone cabochons, stones that have been shaped and smoothed with a flat back and a domed front, primarily intended for jewelry making (such as wire-wrapping or setting in rings and pendants).

You can pick the stine you want, or several, or all of them. I have the price set for one, your choice. If you want to buy them all I will do a better price, you will have to tell me and I will adjust the price before the transaction.All prices include shipping.
